notes.title: Thank You for the Release, Patch Update, and Future Plans
notes.notes:
To all players,
This is MYU, director of Type-NOISE: Shonen Shojo.

On Wednesday, September 17, we successfully released the game. Two days have now passed since launch, and many people have already played it and shared their impressions and reactions on social media and other platforms. It finally feels real that the game has launched, and I am once again reminded that we could only reach this point thanks to everyone’s support. I want to express my heartfelt gratitude!

We carefully read every comment shared through Steam reviews, community posts, and social media. While we are encouraged by the many voices enjoying the game, we have also received reports of bugs and localization issues. We are reviewing these now and preparing to address them as quickly as possible through patch updates.

Based on the issues pointed out in reviews and community posts, we have made urgent fixes today and released a patch that includes bug fixes and localization adjustments.

v1.0.1: Localization and Bug Fixes
＝＝＝
Fixes

Corrected parts of the English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese localization.

Fixed an issue in CHAPTER 1-3 where the movie would not play.

Improved image quality and design of Steam achievement icons (Steam restart recommended).
＝＝＝

As for future updates:
We have received feedback that the English localization feels unnatural. In coordination with our publisher, we plan to review and revise the overall text, with a major update scheduled for the future.
In addition, we are investigating other improvement requests from players to see what can be addressed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033199/38892d8ce9a7c8864c9cb40a051112c3cd1851c7.png[/img]

Next week, I will personally be attending TGS and standing at our booth. I am very much looking forward to meeting you in person and talking about the game!

With all of your feedback in mind, we will continue to work hard to improve the game so that it can be enjoyed more comfortably and without stress.
Thank you again for your continued support of Type-NOISE: Shonen Shojo!

notes.title: 【Noise Report #27】Release Date Set for September 17, 2025!
notes.notes:
To everyone,
This is MYU, the director.

At last, the day has come when I can finally share this news with you.
Type-NOISE: Shonen Shojo will be released on September 17, 2025!!!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033199/2260adf27bd7f9f64bd9514b9aa8c78b04e03898.png[/img]
I’m truly thrilled to finally make this announcement.

Thanks to your participation in the demo and Steam reviews, we’ve received many supportive messages and honest feedback.
To everyone who helped us — thank you so much.

We’re currently polishing the final version based on your input, and the game is now 90% complete.
We’ve entered the final phase of refinement and finishing touches for release.

To bring this title to even more people, we have decided to distribute a Playtest version and strengthen our Steam fan community.
We are committed to making Type-NOISE: Shonen Shojo an even more exciting and captivating experience.
We truly appreciate your continued support and cooperation!

Please note that the Playtest version contains the same content as the currently available Demo.
Whether you are playing Type-NOISE: Shonen Shojo for the first time or have already played the Demo, we would love for you to join us.
Your feedback and opinions will help shape the final product.

Specifically, we’ll be gathering feedback and opinions on our Discord server:

◣◥◣◥◣◥◣◥◣◥◣◥◣◥◣◥
Discord
https://discord.gg/bTMrxgtchv
◣◥◣◥◣◥◣◥◣◥◣◥◣◥◣◥

Starting today, we’ve also released the official release date trailer.
Around the same time, we’ll be appearing at bilibili world (China) and running a wishlist campaign to bring the game to more players.

Only two months left until launch.
We’re sprinting to the finish—thank you again for your continued support!

— MYU

notes.title: [Noise Report #1]Type-NOISE: Shonen Shojo Steam Store Release
notes.notes:
Hello, I'm MYU.
I am responsible for planning, scenario writing, character design, and direction for this project.

Escape from a noise-filled city. A noise-canceling adventure combining puzzles and story interaction.
Type-NOISE: Shonen Shojo
was introduced today at INDIELiveExpo  on May 25, 2024.

In this Noise Report, we will regularly share the latest development information and news!

"Type-NOISE: Shonen Shojo" scheduled for release in 2024, is currently under intense development.
We've spent a lot of time preparing for today... It's just the beginning, but I'm thrilled to finally have it available on the store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033199/6c6a91e7acde256945edde9f5bcbe77e8fd1de8e.png[/img]

We will be sharing information with you in real time as we continue development, and I hope you enjoy this dynamic process.
I've spent more of my life drawing pictures than writing, so some parts may be a bit difficult to read, but I'll do my best!

From next time, we will focus more on the content of the work, introducing characters and gameplay elements!
We plan to post something related to development weekly, so please follow and stay tuned!!
◆We have also opened a Discord server, "Noise Scramble City" today. Feel free to join!
https://discord.gg/C3YMKVBvbV

Also, we would be thrilled if you add the game to your wishlist!!
Thank you very much!!
